cells.code:
CREATE TABLE contact_lists (
    request_id   SERIAL       PRIMARY KEY,
    member_id    INTEGER      NOT NULL,
    name         VARCHAR(20)  NOT NULL,
    reason       VARCHAR(50)  NOT NULL,
    request_date DATE         NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO contact_lists (member_id, name, reason, request_date)
SELECT member_id, name, '이메일 미등록' AS reason, CAST('2026-11-19' AS DATE) AS request_date
FROM members WHERE email IS NULL
UNION
SELECT member_id, name, '전화번호 미등록', '2026-11-19'::DATE
FROM members WHERE phone IS NULL
ORDER BY member_id, reason
RETURNING request_id, member_id, name, reason;
expect: kant_shop=# INSERT INTO contact_lists (member_id, name, reason, request_date)
kant_shop-# SELECT member_id, name, '이메일 미등록' AS reason, CAST('2026-11-19' AS DATE) AS request_date
kant_shop-# FROM members WHERE email IS NULL
kant_shop-# FROM members WHERE phone IS NULL
kant_shop-# RETURNING request_id, member_id, name, reason;
cells.title: 두 SELECT를 날짜로 맞추면 UNION 결과 16줄이 한 번에 들어가요
